text: Based on the evidence, we can confirm with high confidence that this forest has remained intact since 2020. Satellite data (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) show no detectable tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. The asset was 91.77% forested in 2020, and annual observations through 2025 (at 30m resolution) detected no stand-replacing losses. However, very small disturbances (under 0.5 ha) or edge changes might have been missed. For strict compliance purposes, further validation may be needed, but the evidence strongly supports the forest’s intactness since 2020.
